name: av-room-designer
description: QTcal AV Room Designer — standalone React micro-app (2D room canvas, device library, product mapping). Built separately from the main QTcal frontend (a vanilla-JS single-page index.html) because a real-time canvas editor needs persistent DOM/render state that the main app's full innerHTML re-render pattern would destroy on every interaction. Talks to the existing QTcal backend (api/auth.py, api/av_rooms.py) over the same JWT bearer-token API — no new backend of its own.
